title: The Jewel of Seven Stars — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
The Jewel of Seven Stars feels chosen. The evidence says it was installed. The story is a first-person narrative of a young man pulled into an archaeologist's plot to revive Queen Tera, an ancient Egyptian mummy. It explores common fin de siècle themes such as imperialism, the rise of the New Woman and feminism, and societal progress.

Once you see The Jewel of Seven Stars as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. At this point, Hatshepsut became regent to Tuthmose's son, by a concubine, her half-nephew. Rather than being regent to the toddler king, however, Hatshepsut took the throne and declared herself ruler.
